response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not match this role's core requirements. His C++ experience is minimal and dated (roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, plus a thesis project), far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ required. He has no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience, and no demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle background. His fintech exposure (RIDE Capital) was Node/TypeScript work in a retail investment context, which does not satisfy the domain requirement.
strengths: Broad, senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, and systems programming
Strong low-latency/performance engineering background (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid CI/CD, DevOps, and testing culture (TDD, trunk-based development, tooling authorship)
concerns: C++ experience is brief (~6 months) and nearly a decade old; no evidence of Windows-platform C++ depth
No fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
SQL experience appears limited to MySQL/MongoDB, not SQL Server or Oracle

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and performance fundamentals
